sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但查明她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈献”的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 请查看您所用应用或我们网站上本集的节目说明。

sentences.en: 26-year-old Sean Stouty's Facebook page was an extension of himself.
sentences.zh: 26岁的肖恩·斯陶蒂的Facebook主页就是他本人的延伸。

sentences.en: He once shared a post on the social media website that read,
sentences.zh: 他曾在该社交媒体网站上分享过一条动态，上面写着：

sentences.en: I don't know how I would live if I was not on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如果没有Facebook我该怎么生活。

sentences.en: Multiple times a day, Sean would post whatever random thoughts popped into his head, from asking if platypuses could be kept as pets, to musing about celebrities.
sentences.zh: 肖恩一天要发布好几次脑子里冒出的各种随机想法，从询问鸭嘴兽能否当宠物养，到对名人的沉思。

sentences.en: He quoted his favourite television shows and summarised recently viewed episodes of
sentences.zh: 他引用自己最喜欢的电视节目，并总结最近观看的剧集

sentences.en: Malcolm in the Middle.
sentences.zh: 《马尔科姆的一家》。

sentences.en: He was also notably introspective, writing,
sentences.zh: 他也非常善于反省，写道：

sentences.en: Starting next week, I'm going to act totally normal.
sentences.zh: 从下周开始，我要表现得完全正常。

sentences.en: Sean had been diagnosed with autism, a developmental disorder that impaired his ability to communicate and interact.
sentences.zh: 肖恩被诊断出患有自闭症，这是一种损害他沟通和互动能力的发育障碍。

sentences.en: He'd also suffered from seizures since birth, which prevented him from living independently.
sentences.zh: 他自出生起就患有癫痫，这使他无法独立生活。

sentences.en: Attempts to house Sean in an assisted living facility hadn't panned out, and he was unable to work due to being easily overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 将肖恩安置在辅助生活设施中的尝试并未成功，而且由于容易感到不堪重负，他无法工作。

sentences.en: As a young adult, Sean still lived at home with his parents and three younger sisters in the city of Springfield, Missouri.
sentences.zh: 作为一名年轻的成年人，肖恩仍然和父母以及三个年幼的妹妹住在密苏里州斯普林菲尔德市的家中。

sentences.en: Sean's autism made it difficult for him to understand social cues and other people's behaviour.
sentences.zh: 肖恩的自闭症使他很难理解社交暗示和其他人的行为。

sentences.en: Although those who knew Sean thought he was nice and friendly, he could come across as impolite or insensitive to neurotypical strangers.
sentences.zh: 虽然认识肖恩的人认为他很好很友好，但他在神经典型陌生人面前可能会显得不礼貌或不近人情。

sentences.en: He was aware of how his condition impacted others, lamenting on his Facebook page,
sentences.zh: 他意识到自己的病情对其他人产生了怎样的影响，并在自己的Facebook主页上感叹道：

sentences.en: Every so often, Sean posted about his home life, anything from how his family's cars were getting their tyres pressure checked, to venting about his dirty bedroom carpet.
sentences.zh: 肖恩时不时会发布一些关于他家庭生活的动态，内容从家里汽车的轮胎气压是如何检查的，到发泄他对脏卧室地毯的不满。

sentences.en: Then, in early April 2012, Sean's Facebook posts took on a new focus.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2012年4月上旬，肖恩的Facebook动态有了一个新的重点。

sentences.en: He began sharing how his father, Mark Stouty, had started acting strangely.
sentences.zh: 他开始分享他的父亲马克·斯陶蒂如何开始表现得有些奇怪。

sentences.en: As Sean only had several online followers and they rarely engaged with his content, these posts drew little attention.
sentences.zh: 由于肖恩只有几个在线粉丝，而且他们很少与他的内容互动，这些动态几乎没有引起什么关注。

sentences.en: Despite this, Sean continued to provide daily reports about his father's increasingly odd behaviour.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，肖恩还是继续提供关于他父亲日益怪异行为的日常报告。

sentences.en: According to Sean, Mark Stouty was suffering mental problems that were also weakening his body.
sentences.zh: 据肖恩说，马克·斯陶蒂正遭受着精神问题的折磨，这也削弱了他的身体。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: My father is slowly starting to have problems with driving and accomplishing anything.
sentences.zh: 我的父亲开始慢慢在驾驶和完成任何事情上遇到问题。

sentences.en: When he drove a car, the car swerved a little bit.
sentences.zh: 当他开车时，车子会稍微偏离方向。

sentences.en: I had to help him keep the car direction straight and properly turning.
sentences.zh: 我不得不帮他保持车向笔直并正确转弯。

sentences.en: In another post, he claimed his father was so insane that Sean didn't want to be friends with him anymore.
sentences.zh: 在另一篇动态中，他声称他父亲精神错乱得连肖恩都不想再和他做朋友了。

sentences.en: On Saturday April 7, Sean posted,
sentences.zh: 4月7日星期六，肖恩发文称：

sentences.en: The next day, Sean wrote that his father had spent half the day in bed and was struggling with basic physical tasks.
sentences.zh: 第二天，肖恩写道，他父亲在床上躺了半天，连基本的体力活都很难完成。

sentences.en: Then, on Monday April 9, Sean announced,
sentences.zh: 接着，在4月9日星期一天，肖恩宣布：

sentences.en: Sean Stouty wasn't the only one who had noticed Mark's declining health.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·斯陶蒂并不是唯一一个注意到马克健康状况下降的人。

sentences.en: Two days before Mark's death, he'd attended a recording session with his band, a blues outfit called Messing With Destiny.
sentences.zh: 在马克去世前两天，他曾与他的乐队——一支名为“与命运纠缠”的布鲁斯乐队——一起参加了一场录音会议。

sentences.en: As the band's lead singer and guitarist, Mark had to project excitement and enthusiasm in order to put on a great show.
sentences.zh: 作为乐队的主唱兼吉他手，马克必须表现出兴奋和热情，才能呈现一场精彩的演出。

sentences.en: This came naturally to Mark because music was his life's passion.
sentences.zh: 这对于马克来说是自然而然的，因为音乐是他一生的挚爱。

sentences.en: It had even drawn him to his wife, Diane, who was a church organist, and the couple endeavoured to pass their love of music down to their children.
sentences.zh: 音乐甚至将他和妻子黛安吸引到了一起，黛安是一名教堂管风琴手，夫妻俩致力于将他们对音乐的热爱传给孩子们。

sentences.en: Messing with the Destiny was gradually gaining success, booking semi-regular gigs in neighbouring cities and making a small amount of money.
sentences.zh: “与命运纠缠”乐队正逐渐取得成功，在邻近城市预订了半固定的演出并赚取了微薄的收入。

sentences.en: So, during their evening recording session on Friday April 6,
sentences.zh: 因此，在4月6日星期五晚上的录音会议期间，

sentences.en: Mark's bandmates were dismayed to see him uncharacteristically distracted, confused, and slurring his words.
sentences.zh: 马克的乐队成员惊恐地发现他一反常态地心不在焉、神情迷茫，说话也含糊不清。

sentences.en: They didn't think Mark was drunk, but wondered if his poor diet, lack of exercise, or other unhealthy vices might have caught up with him.
sentences.zh: 他们不认为马克喝醉了，但怀疑他糟糕的饮食、缺乏锻炼或其他不健康的不良嗜好可能已经积劳成疾。

sentences.en: Mark also had bipolar disorder, a mental condition hallmarked by drastic mood swings and manic episodes.
sentences.zh: 马克还患有双相情感障碍，这是一种以剧烈情绪波动和狂躁发作为特征的精神疾病。

sentences.en: Perhaps he was just going through a rough period.
sentences.zh: 也许他只是经历了一段艰难的时期。

sentences.en: Mark stayed hydrated and went on several walks outside, hoping to shake whatever ailed him.
sentences.zh: 马克保持水分并外出散了几次步，希望能摆脱任何折磨他的病痛。

sentences.en: Despite losing his appetite, becoming increasingly lethargic, and even vomiting, Mark didn't go to the doctor.
sentences.zh: 尽管食欲不振、日益嗜睡甚至呕吐，马克还是没有去看医生。

sentences.en: Nor did his family push him to seek medical treatment.
sentences.zh: 他的家人也没有催促他寻求医疗救治。

sentences.en: It seemed like he just had a bad case of the flu, nothing that he wouldn't overcome in time.
sentences.zh: 看起来他只是得了重感冒，过一段时间自然就会好起来。

sentences.en: Saturday April 7 was Mark's 61st birthday, and he went to a friend's house to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 4月7日星期六是马克61岁的生日，他去一个朋友家庆祝。

sentences.en: His friend was troubled by Mark's yellow complexion.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友对马克发黄的脸色感到不安。

sentences.en: Diane Stouty checked on her husband throughout the night, but he was too fatigued to say much at all.
sentences.zh: 黛安·斯陶蒂整夜都在照看她的丈夫，但他太疲惫了，几乎说不出什么话来。

sentences.en: By Sunday April 8, Mark was so sick that he couldn't go to church.
sentences.zh: 到4月8日星期日，马克病得连教堂都去不了了。

sentences.en: His absence was surprising, as the Stouties were devout Christians and prominent members of their church community.
sentences.zh: 他的缺席令人惊讶，因为斯陶蒂一家是虔诚的基督徒，也是他们教堂社区的重要成员。

sentences.en: The rest of the family went without Mark, who stayed behind to reSt.
sentences.zh: 其余家人在没有马克的情况下去了教堂，马克则留在家里休息。

sentences.en: Some time after they returned home, they found Mark in bed, unconscious and unresponsive.
sentences.zh: 他们回家后不久，发现马克躺在床上，失去知觉且毫无反应。

sentences.en: Diane called emergency services, but there was nothing they could do.
sentences.zh: 黛安拨打了急救电话，但他们无能为力。

sentences.en: Mark was dead.
sentences.zh: 马克已经死了。

sentences.en: A ring of blood had dried around Mark's mouth.
sentences.zh: 一圈血迹在马克的嘴边干涸。

sentences.en: Other than that, he looked normal and had no signs of injury.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，他看起来很正常，没有任何受伤的迹象。

sentences.en: Diane Stouty was able to detail her husband's final hours, which culminated in him suffering three seizures on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 黛安·斯陶蒂详细叙述了她丈夫最后几个小时的情况，最终他在周日遭受了三次癫痫发作。

sentences.en: He had never had a seizure before.
sentences.zh: 他以前从未发作过癫痫。

sentences.en: The last one occurred 45 minutes before Diane found Mark not breathing.
sentences.zh: 最后一次发作发生在黛安发现马克停止呼吸前45分钟。

sentences.en: She said she'd wanted to call 911 sooner, but Mark had insisted that he didn't want to go to hospital.
sentences.zh: 她说她本来想早点打911，但马克坚称他不想去医院。

sentences.en: Diane explained that Mark had diabetes and was developing Alzheimer's, which was gradually destroying his mental functions.
sentences.zh: 黛安解释说，马克患有糖尿病，并且正在发展为阿尔茨海默病，这正在逐渐摧毁他的精神功能。

sentences.en: This was in addition to liver problems he'd acquired from drinking alcohol in excess.
sentences.zh: 除了这些，他还有因过量饮酒而导致的肝脏问题。

sentences.en: Mark was also a long-time cigarette smoker and would sometimes smoke cannabis.
sentences.zh: 马克还是一个多年的吸烟者，有时会吸食大麻。

sentences.en: Upon observing Mark's body and taking his lifestyle and health into account, the county medical examiner concluded that the 61-year-old must have died of natural causes.
sentences.zh: 在观察了马克的遗体并考虑了他的生活方式和健康状况后，县法医得出结论，这位61岁的老人一定是自然死亡。

sentences.en: They didn't think it was necessary to perform any tests or an autopsy.
sentences.zh: 他们认为没有必要进行任何化验或尸检。

sentences.en: Diane Stouty announced Mark's untimely passing on her Facebook page, telling the couple's devastated friends that her husband of 27 years had reached his eternal home.
sentences.zh: 黛安·斯陶蒂在她的Facebook主页上宣布了马克不幸离世的消息，告诉这对夫妇悲痛欲绝的朋友们，她结婚27年的丈夫已经回到了永恒的家。

sentences.en: She quoted from the Gospel of John,
sentences.zh: 她引用了《约翰福音》中的话：

sentences.en: Mark was cremated and his ashes scattered at a lake.
sentences.zh: 马克被火化了，他的骨灰被撒在了一个湖里。

sentences.en: The remaining members of Messing with Destiny performed a musical tribute for Mark at his memorial service and played his favourite song of theirs, titled Darkest Hour.
sentences.zh: “与命运纠缠”乐队的其余成员在马克的追悼会上为他举行了音乐致敬，并演奏了他们最喜欢的一首他的歌曲，名为《最黑暗的时刻》。

sentences.en: Mark's daughter Rachel paid tribute to her father with a poem by influential German writer Johan Wolfgang von Goethe.
sentences.zh: 马克的女儿蕾切尔用有影响力的德国作家约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德的一首诗向父亲表达了敬意。

sentences.en: Mark's death was a huge blow to his family's dynamic.
sentences.zh: 马克的去世对他的家庭动力是一个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: By all accounts, the Stoutys were happy and full of love, support and understanding.
sentences.zh: 据各方反映，斯陶蒂一家曾经很幸福，充满爱、支持和理解。

sentences.en: Mark was a devoted stay-at-home dad, as all of the Stouty children were reliant on their parents in their own way.
sentences.zh: 马克是一个全职居家好爸爸，因为所有的斯陶蒂孩子都在各自的方面依赖着他们的父母。

sentences.en: Eldest child and only son, Sean, lived with them on account of his health.
sentences.zh: 长子兼唯一的儿子肖恩因为健康原因与他们住在一起。

sentences.en: 24-year-old Sarah, a university graduate who had accrued a large student loan debt, was struggling to find a job.
sentences.zh: 24岁的萨拉是一名大学毕业生，背负着沉重学生贷款债务，一直在艰难地找工作。

sentences.en: 22-year-old Rachel was studying art history at college while pursuing her love of painting and music.
sentences.zh: 22岁的蕾切尔在大学里学习艺术史，同时追求她对绘画和音乐的热爱。

sentences.en: The Stoutys' youngest child, an 11-year-old girl, Casefile will refer to as Tia, had learning difficulties.
sentences.zh: 斯陶蒂家最小的孩子是一个11岁的女孩，档案将其称为蒂亚，她有学习困难。

sentences.en: Mark and Diane were very proud of their children.
sentences.zh: 马克和黛安为他们的孩子们感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: Diane referred to them as little professors, as each was an expert in their own special interests.
sentences.zh: 黛安称他们为小教授，因为每个人都是他们各自特殊兴趣领域的专家。

sentences.en: 51-year-old Diane was the family breadwinner.
sentences.zh: 51岁的黛安是家里的顶梁柱。

sentences.en: She was a cardiology nurse who primarily worked from home assessing insurance company claiMs.
sentences.zh: 她是一名心脏病学护士，主要在家办公，评估保险公司的索赔。

sentences.en: At times, her income was not enough to support the family of six, so Mark took on odd jobs for extra cash.
sentences.zh: 有时，她的收入不足以支撑这个六口之家，于是马克接一些零工来赚取额外现金。

sentences.en: Prior to Mark's passing, the Stoutys lived in a small home in Springfield's suburban weSt.
sentences.zh: 在马克去世之前，斯陶蒂一家住在斯普林菲尔德西郊的一栋小房子里。

sentences.en: Their house needed a lot of work and the neighbourhood had some probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他们的房子需要大修，而且那个社区有一些问题。

sentences.en: Sean Stouty often vented about this on his Facebook page, going so far as to write, I need a better house to live in.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·斯陶蒂经常在自己的Facebook主页上发泄对此的不满，甚至写道：我需要一栋更好的房子住。

sentences.en: His father's modest life insurance payout of $20,000 helped the family relocate to a larger house in a nicer area.
sentences.zh: 他父亲两万美元的微薄人寿保险赔偿金帮助全家搬到了一处环境更好、面积更大的房子里。

sentences.en: Sean was delighted by the move.
sentences.zh: 肖恩对这次搬家感到欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: He posted about it online, writing,
sentences.zh: 他在网上发文写道：

sentences.en: I am going to move out of a neighbourhood of hell to a neighbourhood that has a low crime rate, has good people, has good schools, and has properly built houses.
sentences.zh: 我要搬出这个地狱般的社区，搬到一个犯罪率低、有好人、有好学校、有建造良好的房子的社区。

sentences.en: In late April, Sean opened a new Facebook account in preparation for his fresh start.
sentences.zh: 4月下旬，肖恩开设了一个新的Facebook账户，为他的重新开始做准备。

sentences.en: He continued posting near-daily updates about whatever piqued his interest, but over the following months, his online activity lessened.
sentences.zh: 他继续发布几乎每天更新的动态，内容关于任何激起他兴趣的事物，但在随后的几个月里，他的网络活动减少了。

sentences.en: Sean acknowledged this on Saturday, August 4, 2012, writing that he was sharing fewer posts than he had previously.
sentences.zh: 肖恩在2012年8月4日星期六承认了这一点，他写道自己分享的动态比以前少了。

sentences.en: By September 2012, five months after the unexpected death of Mark Stouty, his family had settled into their new home.
sentences.zh: 到2012年9月，在马克·斯陶蒂意外去世五个月后，他的家人已经在新家安顿下来。

sentences.en: Then, on Sunday, September 2, the Stoutys arrived at their weekly church service with another notable absence.
sentences.zh: 然后，在9月2日星期日，斯陶蒂一家按时去参加每周的礼拜活动，却又有一个显著的缺席。

sentences.en: 26-year-old Sean was unable to attend as he was bedridden after suffering flu-like symptoms for weeks.
sentences.zh: 26岁的肖恩因连续几周出现类似流感的症状而卧床不起，无法出席。

sentences.en: He could do little else but rest and stay hydrated in between long painful bouts of vomiting, head and muscle aches, and appetite loss.
sentences.zh: 在漫长而痛苦的呕吐、头痛、肌肉酸痛以及食欲不振的发作间隙，他除了休息和保持水分之外别无他法。

sentences.en: When the Stoutys returned home from church, they found Sean unconscious on his bedroom floor.
sentences.zh: 当斯陶蒂一家从教堂回家时，他们发现肖恩失去知觉地躺在卧室的地上。

sentences.en: A ring of dried blood had formed around his mouth.
sentences.zh: 一圈干涸的血迹在他的嘴周围形成。

sentences.en: Just like his father months earlier, Sean had died unexpectedly after enduring a mysterious illness.
sentences.zh: 就像几个月前的父亲一样，肖恩在忍受了一种神秘的疾病后意外死亡。

sentences.en: On this occasion, the county medical examiner performed an autopsy.
sentences.zh: 这一次，县法医进行了尸检。

sentences.en: It revealed that Sean had a congenital kidney defect, signs of brain damage and a stroke, as well as damage to his central nervous system.
sentences.zh: 结果显示，肖恩患有先天性肾脏缺陷，有脑损伤和中风的迹象，以及中枢神经系统受损。

sentences.en: Given Sean's history of seizures and other health issues, the medical examiner assumed that the young man had been struck down by a pre-existing condition.
sentences.zh: 鉴于肖恩有癫痫病史和其他健康问题，法医认为这个年轻人是被既往疾病击倒的。

sentences.en: Sean's death was officially ruled as being due to prior medical issues.
sentences.zh: 肖恩的死因被官方裁定为由于先前的医疗问题。

sentences.en: The sudden deaths of Mark and Sean so close together left the local community reeling.
sentences.zh: 马克和肖恩如此接近的突然离世让当地社区震动。

sentences.en: Friends of the Stoutys were shocked that a loving, pious family could have such awful luck.
sentences.zh: 斯陶蒂一家的朋友们感到震惊，一个充满爱心、虔诚的家庭怎么会有如此糟糕的运气。

sentences.en: Two days after Sean's death, Diane Stouty posted a short tribute to her son on her Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 在肖恩去世两天后，黛安·斯陶蒂在她的Facebook主页上发布了一则简短的悼词来纪念她的儿子。

sentences.en: It's been hard for me to come up with the right words, Diane wrote.
sentences.zh: 黛安写道，我很难找到合适的词语。

sentences.en: But here goes.
sentences.zh: 但还是要写。

sentences.en: On Sunday, my oldest child, Sean, died.
sentences.zh: 周日，我的大孩子肖恩去世了。

sentences.en: Although he had been sick lately, we thought he was getting better.
sentences.zh: 尽管他最近一直生病，但我们以为他正在好转。

sentences.en: Diane went on to thank those who had been keeping her family in their prayers.
sentences.zh: 黛安接着感谢那些一直为她的家庭祈祷的人。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: Everyone was devastated for the now family of four who grew noticeably reclusive after Sean's death.
sentences.zh: 所有人都为这个如今只剩四个人的家庭感到痛心，他们在肖恩死后明显变得隐居起来。

sentences.en: His remains were cremated, but unlike his father, there was no funeral or memorial to honour his life.
sentences.zh: 他的遗体被火化了，但与他的父亲不同的是，没有举行葬礼或追悼会来纪念他的一生。

sentences.en: Diane Stouty seemed to be taking the loss of her husband and son in her stride.
sentences.zh: 黛安·斯陶蒂似乎从容地应对着丈夫和儿子的离去。

sentences.en: She focused on taking care of her three daughters, Sarah, Rachel and Tia, and threw herself into her music and church commitments.
sentences.zh: 她专注于照顾她的三个女儿萨拉、蕾切尔和蒂亚，并全身心投入到她的音乐和教堂事务中。

sentences.en: The local community rallied around Diane, who responded well to the guidance and support provided by her pastors.
sentences.zh: 当地社区纷纷支持黛安，她对牧师们提供的指导和支持反应良好。

sentences.en: Even Diane's daughter, Rachel, was struck by how well her mother coped in the aftermath of Sean's inexplicable death.
sentences.zh: 甚至黛安的女儿蕾切尔也对母亲在肖恩莫名其妙去世后表现得如此镇定感到震惊。

sentences.en: Rachel posted on her Facebook page,
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔在她的Facebook主页上发文称：

sentences.en: Don't think I've seen mum so chilled out like this in a long time.
sentences.zh: 我觉得好久没见妈妈这么淡定过了。

sentences.en: But this moment of calm was short-lived.
sentences.zh: 但这段平静的时光并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: Nine months after the death of Sean, the Stouty family was hit with more misfortune.
sentences.zh: 在肖恩去世九个月后，斯陶蒂一家又遭厄运。

sentences.en: 24-year-old Sarah Stouty had been found unconscious in bed after suffering severe flu-like symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 24岁的萨拉·斯陶蒂在遭受严重的流感样症状后被发现失去知觉地躺在床上。

sentences.en: Diane bundled her eldest daughter into her car and rushed her to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 黛安把她的大女儿抱上车，急忙送往医院。

sentences.en: By the time Sarah arrived at the emergency department, her condition was so dire that she was swiftly admitted to the intensive care unit.
sentences.zh: 当萨拉到达急诊室时，她的病情已经非常危急，迅速被送进了重症监护室。

sentences.en: Doctors soon discovered that Sarah wasn't just dealing with a nasty strain of the flu.
sentences.zh: 医生很快发现萨拉不仅仅是感染了恶性的流感病毒。

sentences.en: Her kidneys had shut down, her pancreas was failing, and her brain was hemorrhaging blood.
sentences.zh: 她的肾脏已经衰竭，胰腺也在罢工，大脑正在脑出血。

sentences.en: Sarah had suffered a total body collapse.
sentences.zh: 萨拉的身体全面崩溃了。

sentences.en: She'd had numerous strokes and seizures and most likely wouldn't survive.
sentences.zh: 她经历多次中风和癫痫发作，很可能无法幸存。

sentences.en: Multiple tests were performed, but the cause of Sarah's illness remained a mystery.
sentences.zh: 进行了多项检测，但萨拉生病的原因仍然是个谜。

sentences.en: Diane Stouty took to Facebook to inform her friends of her family's latest tragedy.
sentences.zh: 黛安·斯陶蒂在Facebook上向朋友们通报了她家的最新悲剧。

sentences.en: She wrote,
sentences.zh: 她写道：

sentences.en: Asking for prayers, as my daughter Sarah is in critical condition in the ICU tonight.
sentences.zh: 请求大家为我们祈祷，我的女儿萨拉今晚在ICU情况危急。

sentences.en: She followed this up with an image that featured the biblical verse,
sentences.zh: 她接着附上了一张带有圣经经文的图片：

sentences.en: Rejoice in our confident hope, be patient in trouble, and keep on praying.
sentences.zh: 在指望中要喜乐，在患难中要忍耐，祷告要恒切。

sentences.en: As news of Sarah Stouty's ordeal spread, Springfield police received a troubling phone call.
sentences.zh: 随着萨拉·斯陶蒂遭遇的消息传开，斯普林菲尔德警方接到了一个令人不安的电话。

sentences.en: The man on the other line said he wished to remain anonymous, but claimed to be a pastor at the Stouty's church.
sentences.zh: 电话那头的男子表示希望保持匿名，但自称是斯陶蒂一家所在教堂的牧师。

sentences.en: Upon hearing about Sarah's illness, he'd become overwhelmed with concern.
sentences.zh: 在听到萨拉生病的消息后，他感到忧心如焚。

sentences.en: Through his work, he had encountered many people who'd experienced considerable hardship and loss.
sentences.zh: 通过他的工作，他遇到过许多经历过重大苦难和损失的人。

sentences.en: However, he had never come across a family who had endured so much indiscriminate death in such a short time span as the Stoutys.
sentences.zh: 然而，他从未遇到过一个家庭在如此短的时间内经历如此多的无差别死亡，就像斯陶蒂一家一样。

sentences.en: He brought up the close timing of Mark and Sean's deaths, which had been excused on account of their respective histories of poor health.
sentences.zh: 他提到了马克和肖恩去世的时间非常接近，当时这些都被归咎于他们各自的不良健康史。

sentences.en: But now, the otherwise healthy Sarah was fighting for her life in a similar scenario.
sentences.zh: 但现在，原本健康的萨拉在类似的情况下为生命而战。

sentences.en: The pastor had been counselling Diane Stouty and was struck by her lack of emotion in relation to it all.
sentences.zh: 这位牧师一直在辅导黛安·斯陶蒂，并对她面对这一切时缺乏情感波澜感到震惊。

sentences.en: He had come to believe something was seriously amiss in the Stouty home.
sentences.zh: 他开始相信，斯陶蒂家中有些地方出了严重的问题。

sentences.en: Police went to speak with the physicians treating Sarah Stouty.
sentences.zh: 警方前往与治疗莎拉·斯陶蒂的医生进行交谈。

sentences.en: They had performed multiple tests to identify what was impacting her, but everything medical or genetic was ruled out.
sentences.zh: 他们已经进行了多项检查以确定是什么在折磨她，但所有医疗或基因方面的原因都被排除了。

sentences.en: Although there was no trace of alcohol, illicit drugs or poisons in Sarah's system, a doctor remarked that her condition was very suspicious.
sentences.zh: 尽管莎拉体内没有酒精、违禁药物或毒物的痕迹，但一位医生指出她的病情非常可疑。

sentences.en: A nurse had more to add.
sentences.zh: 护士有更多情况要补充。

sentences.en: Sarah was barely clinging to life, but her mother Diane had only visited her a couple of times.
sentences.zh: 莎拉生命垂危，但她的母亲黛安只来看望过她几次。

sentences.en: Moreover, Diane's behaviour was described as inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 此外，黛安的行为被形容为很不合时宜。

sentences.en: She joked and laughed with hospital staff about her daughter's condition and said that she planned to go on a vacation to Florida soon, regardless of Sarah's status.
sentences.zh: 她拿女儿的病情和医院工作人员开玩笑、大笑，并表示无论莎拉状况如何，她都计划很快去佛罗里达度假。

sentences.en: Police came to learn that Diane had also acted strangely after her husband and son's deaths.
sentences.zh: 警方后来了解到，在丈夫和儿子去世后，黛安的举止同样很古怪。

sentences.en: According to friends of the Stoutys, Diane treated Mark's memorial service like a party.
sentences.zh: 据斯陶蒂一家的朋友透露，黛安把马克（Mark）的追悼会办得像个派对。

sentences.en: She displayed no outward expressions of grief and seemed more concerned about being the perfect host and making sure guests were catered to.
sentences.zh: 她没有表现出任何外在的悲痛，反而似乎更关心如何做一个完美的东道主，确保宾客照顾周到。

sentences.en: When a neighbour saw the coroner's van outside the Stouty home after Sean's death, she rushed over to check on the family.
sentences.zh: 当一位邻居在肖恩（Sean）死后看到验尸官的货车停在斯陶蒂家门外时，她赶忙跑过去查看情况。

sentences.en: Diane answered the door and the neighbour asked if everything was alright.
sentences.zh: 黛安打开了门，邻居问一切是否安好。

sentences.en: Diane responded casually,
sentences.zh: 黛安随口答道：

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, my son died.
sentences.zh: 哦，对啊，我儿子死了。

sentences.en: Online, Diane barely mentioned her husband and son beyond brief obligatory death notices.
sentences.zh: 在网络上，黛安除了发布简短例行的讣告外，几乎不怎么提及丈夫和儿子。

sentences.en: Within days, she was back to posting positive Bible quotes and silly memes.
sentences.zh: 几天之内，她又开始发布积极的圣经名言和搞笑表情包。

sentences.en: As detectives began re-examining the deaths of Mark and Sean Stouty, Diane agreed to be interviewed, unaware that any investigations were taking place.
sentences.zh: 正当侦探们开始重新调查马克和肖恩·斯陶蒂的死因时，黛安同意接受采访，浑然不知调查正在进行。

sentences.en: She was first asked about Sarah.
sentences.zh: 她首先被问及关于莎拉的情况。

sentences.en: Diane explained how a week earlier Sarah had complained of a mild headache and stomach upset, which resulted in her vomiting a few times.
sentences.zh: 黛安解释说，一周前莎拉抱怨有轻微的头痛和胃部不适，导致她吐了几次。

sentences.en: To Diane, Sarah's illness didn't seem that bad as she had seen worse cases of the flu.
sentences.zh: 对黛安来说，莎拉的病看起来并不算严重，因为她见过滤得更重的流感病例。

sentences.en: Sarah spent most of her time in bed, only emerging to vomit into the toilet.
sentences.zh: 莎拉大部分时间都呆在床上，只有去马桶呕吐时才会出来。

sentences.en: She had no appetite but was able to take fluids.
sentences.zh: 她没有胃口，但还能喝水。

sentences.en: Diane said Sarah's usual schedule consisted of her staying up all night with friends and sleeping during the day, so she hadn't noticed anything was seriously off until Sunday.
sentences.zh: 黛安说，莎拉通常的作息是整晚和朋友熬夜，白天睡觉，所以直到周日她才发现情况严重不对劲。

sentences.en: That morning, Sarah was bedridden and unable to attend church.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，莎拉卧床不起，无法去教堂。

sentences.en: The rest of the family went without her.
sentences.zh: 家里其余人都没有带她去。

sentences.en: When they returned home at around 12.30pm, Sarah was still in bed, seemingly resting.
sentences.zh: 当他们在下午12点半左右回到家时，莎拉仍然躺在床上，似乎在休息。

sentences.en: Hours passed before Diane went to check on her again.
sentences.zh: 几个小时过去了，黛安才去再次查看她的情况。

sentences.en: By then, Sarah was unresponsive.
sentences.zh: 到那时，莎拉已经没有反应了。

sentences.en: Diane carried Sarah out to the car and rushed her to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 黛安把莎拉抱到车里，匆忙把她送到医院。

sentences.en: Despite being a trained nurse, Diane was mystified as to what had caused Sarah's illness.
sentences.zh: 尽管受过专业护士训练，黛安对导致莎拉生病的原因却感到迷惑不解。

sentences.en: All she could say was that it had done a number on her.
sentences.zh: 她唯一能说的是，这把她折腾得够呛。

sentences.en: When asked if Sarah might have harmed herself, Diane said that was a possibility.
sentences.zh: 当被问及莎拉是否可能伤害了自己时，黛安说有这种可能。

sentences.en: Sarah had bipolar disorder like her father and had threatened self-harm in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 莎拉和她父亲一样患有双相情感障碍，过去曾威胁过要自残。

sentences.en: But Diane asserted that her daughter's behaviour had been fine lately.
sentences.zh: 但黛安坚称她女儿最近的表现一直很好。

sentences.en: She'd also checked Sarah's medication and it appeared normal, ruling out the possibility that she had overdosed on it.
sentences.zh: 她还检查了莎拉的药物，看起来很正常，从而排除了她过量服药的可能性。

sentences.en: Diane suggested that Sarah might have, quote, gotten into the cleaners, meaning that she could have intentionally consumed poisonous household cleaning products.
sentences.zh: 黛安暗示莎拉可能，引述的话，沾染了清洁剂，意思是她可能有意服用了有毒的家用清洁产品。

sentences.en: Diane was asked to be more specific.
sentences.zh: 黛安被要求说得更具体一点。

sentences.en: She responded with a laugh.
sentences.zh: 她笑着回答。

sentences.en: What do I have?
sentences.zh: 我能有什么办法？

sentences.en: I can't see her taking soap.
sentences.zh: 我看不出她会去吃肥皂。

sentences.en: Yuck.
sentences.zh: 真恶心。

sentences.en: Diane was then asked what she thought happened to Sarah.
sentences.zh: 接着，黛安被问及她认为莎拉发生了什么事。

sentences.en: She fell silent for a moment before replying with an exasperated sigh.
sentences.zh: 她沉默了一会儿，然后发出一声无奈的叹息回答道。

sentences.en: I really don't know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: I've been trying to rack my brain to figure out what happened.
sentences.zh: 我一直在绞尽脑汁想弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: I really can't think of anything.
sentences.zh: 我真的想不出什么。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It just doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: Diane was told that further tests would be carried out to establish what exactly happened to Sarah.
sentences.zh: 黛安被告知将进行进一步检测以确定莎拉究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: When asked if she thought anything suspicious might be found, Diane responded,
sentences.zh: 当被问及她是否认为会发现任何可疑之处时，黛安回答：

sentences.en: I have no clue.
sentences.zh: 我毫无头绪。

sentences.en: I don't even know what to look for.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道该找什么。

sentences.en: I mean, if they're looking for some kind of chemical that she may have taken, I can't think of what it would be.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他们是在找她可能服用的某种化学物质，我想不出会是什么。

sentences.en: And if the tests did come back confirming the presence of a chemical, how would Diane explain that?
sentences.zh: 如果检测结果确实证实存在某种化学物质，黛安又该如何解释？

sentences.en: She shrugged her shoulders and answered, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 她耸耸肩回答，我不知道。

sentences.en: Mark and Sean Stouty were both cremated, but Sean was autopsied beforehand.
sentences.zh: 马克和肖恩·斯陶蒂都被火化了，但肖恩在火化前做过尸检。

sentences.en: As part of that process, the medical examiner had taken samples of Sean's tissue, blood and hair.
sentences.zh: 作为该流程的一部分，法医提取了肖恩的组织、血液和毛发样本。

sentences.en: The samples were stored for a certain amount of time post-mortem, allowing for additional testing to take place if necessary.
sentences.zh: 这些样本在死后被保存了一定时间，以便在必要时进行额外的检测。

sentences.en: Although Mark wasn't autopsied, samples of the dried blood around his mouth had been collected and similarly stored.
sentences.zh: 尽管马克没有进行尸检，但他嘴边干涸血迹的样本被采集并同样保存了下来。

sentences.en: The interviewing detective asked Diane,
sentences.zh: 负责问话的侦探问黛安：

sentences.en: Is there any reason that from samples taken that there might be some sort of correlation, some kind of link, something that might be similar between them?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么理由能说明，从提取的样本来看，它们之间可能存在某种关联、某种联系，或者某种相似之处？

sentences.en: Diane gently shook her head and replied,
sentences.zh: 黛安轻轻摇了摇头，回答说：

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: The detective pressed on.
sentences.zh: 侦探继续追问。

sentences.en: And if there was, what would your explanation be?
sentences.zh: 如果有的话，你的解释是什么？

sentences.en: Diane repeated,
sentences.zh: 黛安重复道：

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: The detective then abruptly asked,
sentences.zh: 随后侦探突然问道：

sentences.en: What was Mark's life insurance policy like?
sentences.zh: 马克的寿险保单是怎么样的？

sentences.en: Diane divulged that Mark's $20,000 life insurance payout had helped pay for a nicer home.
sentences.zh: 黛安透露，马克两万美元的人寿保险赔偿金帮助支付了一套更好的房子。

sentences.en: Diane intended to use Sean's $15,000 payout for bills.
sentences.zh: 黛安打算用肖恩的一万五千美元赔偿金来支付账单。

sentences.en: Sarah's policy would net Diane a further $15,000.
sentences.zh: 莎拉的保单将为黛安再带来一万五千美元。

sentences.en: Her other two daughters' amounts were the same.
sentences.zh: 她另外两个女儿的金额也是一样的。

sentences.en: Diane was asked what she would spend Sarah's life insurance payout on.
sentences.zh: 黛安被问到她会把莎拉的人寿保险赔偿金花在什么上面。

sentences.en: I have no clue, she replied.
sentences.zh: 我毫无头绪，她回答道。

sentences.en: By now, Diane's mood had shifted.
sentences.zh: 此时，黛安的情绪已经发生了转变。

sentences.en: She'd become solemn and contemplative, allowing for long moments of silence before answering questions.
sentences.zh: 她变得严肃而沉思，在回答问题前会有长时间的沉默。

sentences.en: When asked if there was anyone that would want to harm her family, Diane claimed that Mark had a lot of weird acquaintances who were into drugs.
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否有谁会想要伤害她的家人时，黛安声称马克有很多沉迷毒品的怪异熟人。

sentences.en: As for her kids, she said, I can't imagine anybody trying to harm them.
sentences.zh: 至于她的孩子们，她说，我无法想象任何人会试图伤害他们。

sentences.en: Diane was encouraged to open up about her marriage with Mark.
sentences.zh: 黛安被鼓励敞开心扉谈谈她与马克的婚姻。

sentences.en: She eventually admitted that it wasn't good, saying that Mark had a binge drinking problem, a cannabis habit, and had been unfaithful to her.
sentences.zh: 她最终承认这段婚姻并不好，并称马克有酗酒问题、吸大麻的习惯，而且对她不忠。

sentences.en: Diane could never bring herself to kick him out, as she feared he would take his own life.
sentences.zh: 黛安一直狠不下心把他赶出去，因为她担心他会自寻短见。

sentences.en: When Mark died, it was actually a relief.
sentences.zh: 当马克死去时，这其实是一种解脱。

sentences.en: I just don't tell people that, Diane admitted, before adding.
sentences.zh: 我只是不跟别人说这些，黛安承认道，随后补充说。

sentences.en: Despite all his faults, I still loved him.
sentences.zh: 尽管他有种种缺点，我依然爱他。

sentences.en: Suspecting Diane was holding back information, the interviewing detective appealed to her religious beliefs.
sentences.zh: 由于怀疑黛安有所隐瞒，问话的侦探从她的宗教信仰入手进行劝说。

sentences.en: Referring to her as a God-fearing woman, he asserted that the right thing to do was to speak honestly and ask for forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 他称她为敬畏上帝的女性，并断言正确做法是诚实说话并寻求宽恕。

sentences.en: He told her, I think you're a very good lady with the right intentions.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，我觉得你是个心地善良、初衷很好的女士。

sentences.en: Everybody reaches a tipping point or a breaking point.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会达到一个临界点或崩溃点。

sentences.en: Maybe certain decisions are made that normally wouldn't be made.
sentences.zh: 也许会做出平时不会做出的某些决定。

sentences.en: Oftentimes, the best way to ask for forgiveness is to talk about it and give an explanation.
sentences.zh: 通常，寻求宽恕的最好方法就是说出来并做出解释。

sentences.en: Diane expressed fear of going to jail.
sentences.zh: 黛安表达了对坐牢的恐惧。

sentences.en: She was told to put that thought aside and to just focus on showing remorse and seeking forgiveness.
sentences.zh: 她被告知把这个想法抛在一边，专注于表现出悔意并寻求宽恕。

sentences.en: Finally, after two hours of questioning, Diane flatly admitted,
sentences.zh: 最后，经过两个小时的审讯，黛安直截了当地承认了：

sentences.en: Antifreeze is an additive that lowers the freezing point of a water-based liquid.
sentences.zh: 防冻液是一种降低水基液体冰点的添加剂。

sentences.en: It is used in vehicles to stop the water in the engine cooling system from freezing during winter months.
sentences.zh: 它用于汽车中，以防止发动机冷却系统中的水在冬季结冰。

sentences.en: Commonly known as engine coolant, antifreeze can be purchased at motoring supply shops and gas stations and is a common item found in residential garages.
sentences.zh: 防冻液通常被称为发动机冷却液，可以在汽车用品店和加油站买到，是住宅车库里常见的物品。

sentences.en: It is extremely hazardous when ingested.
sentences.zh: 它在吞食后极度危险。

sentences.en: It only takes a small amount of antifreeze to poison the human body, with the symptoms appearing gradually over several hours.
sentences.zh: 只需极少量的防冻液就能让人体中毒，症状会在几小时内逐渐显现。

sentences.en: The impacted person can feel or appear inebriated and suffer from headaches, fatigue, lack of coordination, grogginess, slurred speech, nausea and vomiting.
sentences.zh: 受影响的人会感到或表现得像喝醉了一样，并遭受头痛、疲劳、协调能力差、昏昏沉沉、言语不清、恶心和呕吐。

sentences.en: As the body breaks down the antifreeze, the chemical can interfere with kidney, lung, brain and nervous system function, with organ damage occurring 24 to 72 hours after ingestion.
sentences.zh: 随着身体分解防冻液，这种化学物质会干扰肾脏、肺部、大脑和神经系统的功能，并在摄入后24至72小时内发生器官损伤。

sentences.en: It results in rapid breathing, a racing heartbeat and convulsions, concluding with loss of consciousness and death.
sentences.zh: 它会导致呼吸急促、心跳加速和抽搐，最终导致意识丧失和死亡。

sentences.en: Diane Stoughty was asked how she knew her family members were drinking antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 黛安·斯陶蒂被问及她是如何知道她的家人在喝防冻液的。

sentences.en: She replied,
sentences.zh: 她回答说：

sentences.en: Because I saw them drinking it.
sentences.zh: 因为我看到他们喝了。

sentences.en: I didn't know what else to do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么办了。

sentences.en: I really didn't.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: Diane admitted that she had reached a breaking point.
sentences.zh: 黛安承认她已经到了崩溃的边缘。

sentences.en: She claimed she didn't want to hurt her family, she was just mad.
sentences.zh: 她声称她不想伤害家人，她只是很生气。

sentences.en: She was tired of working hard to provide for them while they took advantage of her and showed little appreciation.
sentences.zh: 她厌倦了辛苦工作来养活他们，而他们却利用她并表现得缺乏感激之情。

sentences.en: In Diane's words, Mark was a deadbeat who stayed home drinking, smoking and enjoying his music.
sentences.zh: 用黛安的话说，马克是个游手好闲的人，整天在家喝酒、抽烟、享受音乐。

sentences.en: Diane had grown to hate her husband and said he lashed out violently at her and their kids.
sentences.zh: 黛安渐渐恨起了她的丈夫，并称他对她和孩子们大打出手。

sentences.en: She couldn't stand being with him any longer, so she killed him.
sentences.zh: 她再也无法忍受和他在一起，所以她杀了他。

sentences.en: She did the same to Sean because she was fed up with caring for him.
sentences.zh: 她对肖恩也做了同样的事，因为她厌倦了照顾他。

sentences.en: She described Sean as more than a bother, more than a pest, who was always interfering in everything she did.
sentences.zh: 她把肖恩形容为不仅仅是个麻烦、不仅仅是个害虫，他总是插手她做的每一件事。

sentences.en: Sean's autism prevented him from holding down a job.
sentences.zh: 肖恩的自闭症使他无法保住一份工作。

sentences.en: Diane felt he was being willfully disobedient in his inability to contribute to the household.
sentences.zh: 黛安觉得他无法为家庭做贡献是在故意不听话。

sentences.en: She felt the same towards Sarah.
sentences.zh: 她对莎拉也有同样的看法。

sentences.en: They often argued about how Sarah didn't try hard enough to get a job.
sentences.zh: 她们经常为莎拉没有努力找工作而争吵。

sentences.en: Diane killed Sarah because she didn't want to wind up paying off her student loan debt.
sentences.zh: 黛安杀了莎拉，因为她不想最后还得替她还清学生贷款债务。

sentences.en: She felt very differently about her two youngest children, Rachel and Tia.
sentences.zh: 她对两个最小的孩子瑞秋（Rachel）和蒂亚（Tia）有着截然不同的看法。

sentences.en: They treated her well and caused no grief, so Diane hadn't poisoned them.
sentences.zh: 她们对她很好，没有带来痛苦，所以黛安没有毒害她们。

sentences.en: She put it bluntly,
sentences.zh: 她直言不讳地说道：

sentences.en: Diane had researched online and learned about the harmful qualities of antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 黛安在网上进行了搜索，并了解了防冻液的有害特性。

sentences.en: It was easy to acquire and, because of its sweet taste and lack of odour, easy to disguise.
sentences.zh: 它很容易买到，而且因为味道甜、没有气味，所以很容易掩盖。

sentences.en: No one would suspect Mark, Sean or Sarah had been poisoned with antifreeze unless medical personnel knew to look for it, as its symptoms were similar to many normal ailments.
sentences.zh: 没有人会怀疑马克、肖恩或莎拉是被防冻液毒害的，除非医务人员知道去寻找它，因为它的症状与许多常见疾病相似。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the chemical's raw components were easily missed in an autopsy because they weren't part of normal toxicology screenings and required advanced testing to detect.
sentences.zh: 此外，该化学物质的原始成分在尸检中很容易被漏掉，因为它们不属于常规毒理学筛查的一部分，需要高级检测才能检测出来。

sentences.en: Diane ordered bottles of antifreeze online and poured a couple of teaspoons into Gatorade for Mark and Coca-Cola for her children.
sentences.zh: 黛安在网上订购了瓶装防冻液，并在马克的佳得乐饮料里和她孩子的可口可乐里倒了几茶匙。

sentences.en: She served the lethal concoction to her unsuspecting victims over a period of several weeks.
sentences.zh: 她在几周的时间里，将这种致命的混合物端给了毫无防备的受害者。

sentences.en: The poison took effect within days, but often just resulted in mild flu-like symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 毒药在几天内就起效了，但通常只导致类似流感的轻微症状。

sentences.en: When Diane's target didn't die quick enough, she increased the dosage of antifreeze until it had its desired effect.
sentences.zh: 当黛安的目标死得不够快时，她便增加了防冻液的剂量，直到达到预期的效果。

sentences.en: Following Diane's shocking confession, detectives arrested her and began seeking more information about the stouty family dynamic.
sentences.zh: 在黛安令人震惊的供认之后，侦探们逮捕了她，并开始搜集更多关于斯陶蒂家族动态的信息。

sentences.en: Sarah was still in hospital and 11-year-old Tia was traumatised by her family's ongoing suffering.
sentences.zh: 莎拉仍在地留院治疗，11岁的蒂亚则因家人持续遭受的折磨而受到心灵创伤。

sentences.en: Yet, there was still one other sibling who could provide some insight.
sentences.zh: 然而，还有一个兄弟姐妹可以提供一些见解。

sentences.en: 22-year-old Rachel Stouty agreed to speak with police.
sentences.zh: 22岁的瑞秋·斯陶蒂同意与警方交谈。

sentences.en: She was unaware that her mother had admitted to poisoning her father, brother and older sister.
sentences.zh: 她并不知道她的母亲已经承认毒害了她的父亲、兄弟和姐姐。

sentences.en: In contrast to Diane's account, Rachel said that Mark was a nice dad who fostered his children's independence.
sentences.zh: 与黛安的说法相反，瑞秋说马克是个好父亲，鼓励孩子们独立。

sentences.en: She admitted that her parents argued a little bit over money, but no more than any other married couple.
sentences.zh: 她承认她的父母确实为钱争吵过一点，但并不比其他任何已婚夫妇多。

sentences.en: Sometimes, Diane took issue with Mark's friends as they drank and smoked.
sentences.zh: 有时，黛安对马克的那些喝酒抽烟的朋友有意见。

sentences.en: Rachel recalled her parents breaking a table during one disagreement, but overall they were close and had a pretty good relationship.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋回忆起父母曾在一次争执中弄坏了一张桌子，但总体而言他们很亲密，关系相当不错。

sentences.en: She saw no abuse and the only bad things she had to say about her father had come from her mother.
sentences.zh: 她没有看到任何虐待行为，她对父亲唯一的坏话都是从她母亲那里听来的。

sentences.en: As for Sean, Rachel said he was extremely low-maintenance.
sentences.zh: 至于肖恩，瑞秋说他极其让人省心。

sentences.en: All he needed was a puzzle or comic book and he was, quote, a happy camper.
sentences.zh: 他只需要一个拼图或一本漫画书，用引述的话来说，他就是个快乐的露营者。

sentences.en: Sean was independent and content being alone.
sentences.zh: 肖恩很独立，一个人也很满足。

sentences.en: Hardly the imposing past Diane had made him out to be.
sentences.zh: 这与黛安把他塑造成的那种气势汹汹的过去完全不相符。

sentences.en: Rachel didn't consider him to be a burden at all.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋一点也不觉得他是个负担。

sentences.en: He had a good relationship with his siblings, especially Sarah.
sentences.zh: 他和兄弟姐妹关系很好，尤其是莎拉。

sentences.en: Rachel said that when Sean was sick, everyone took turns looking after him, though their mother primarily cared for him during the day while she worked from home.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋说，当肖恩生病时，大家轮流照顾他，不过主要还是他们的母亲在他白天居家办公时照顾他。

sentences.en: Diane gave him Coca-Cola as it was one of the few things he could stomach.
sentences.zh: 黛安给他可口可乐，因为这是他少数能吃得下的东西之一。

sentences.en: When asked about her mother's reaction to Sean's passing, Rachel said Diane wished they could have done more for him.
sentences.zh: 当被问及母亲对肖恩离世的反应时，雷切尔说黛安希望他们能为他做更多的事。

sentences.en: She felt like a failure as a mum because it was one thing to lose your husband, but far worse to lose a child.
sentences.zh: 她觉得自己是一个失败的母亲，因为失去丈夫是一回事，而失去孩子则要痛苦得多。

sentences.en: Rachel remembered when Sarah fell ill, too.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔回想起萨拉生病的时候。

sentences.en: The toilet was right across from her bedroom and at night she could hear Sarah going in to vomit.
sentences.zh: 洗手间就在她卧室的正对面，到了晚上她能听到萨拉进去呕吐的声音。

sentences.en: Rachel tried to convince Sarah to eat, but she had no appetite.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔试图劝萨拉吃点东西，但她毫无食欲。

sentences.en: She could manage to drink, though, so Rachel and Diane would bring her fluids.
sentences.zh: 不过她还能喝得下水，于是雷切尔和黛安会给她拿流食。

sentences.en: Things eventually deteriorated to the point where Sarah couldn't get up off the floor.
sentences.zh: 情况最终恶化到萨拉连从地上爬起来都做不到的地步。

sentences.en: When she lost consciousness, Rachel helped carry her out to the car and take her to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 当她失去意识时，雷切尔帮忙把她抬到车上并送往医院。

sentences.en: According to Rachel, Diane expressed guilt over Sarah's predicament, too, lamenting that she should have taken her to the hospital sooner.
sentences.zh: 据雷切尔所说，黛安对萨拉的困境也表达了内疚，感叹自己应该早点把她送到医院。

sentences.en: Rachel also recalled the time Sarah had threatened to self-harm.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔还回忆起萨拉曾扬言要自残的那次。

sentences.en: It was during middle school and Rachel was certain it was only a cry for help.
sentences.zh: 那是初中时的事，雷切尔确信那只是一种求救的信号。

sentences.en: Since then, Sarah hadn't expressed any suicidal thoughts.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，萨拉再也没有表露过任何自杀的念头。

sentences.en: She had been a high achiever at college and was otherwise doing well.
sentences.zh: 她在大学里成绩优异，各方面表现都很不错。

sentences.en: Rachel admitted that Sarah wasn't trying very hard to find work, though her options were limited.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔承认萨拉并没有很努力地去找工作，尽管她的选择也很有限。

sentences.en: She had degrees in French and history, and her interests lay in teaching or translating French, but there weren't many opportunities in Missouri as most students learnt Spanish.
sentences.zh: 她拥有法语和历史学位，兴趣在于教法语或从事法语翻译，但在密苏里州机会并不多，因为大多数学生都学西班牙语。

sentences.en: It was normal for Sarah to spend the day on her computer watching videos online instead of helping out around the house.
sentences.zh: 萨拉整天泡在电脑上上网看视频，而不是帮忙做家务，这很正常。

sentences.en: Rachel was more frustrated with Sarah than her mother seemed to be.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔对萨拉的沮丧似乎比她母亲还要多。

sentences.en: Although Diane was disappointed by Sarah's lack of effort, she was patient with her.
sentences.zh: 尽管黛安对萨拉不肯努力感到失望，但她对萨拉很有耐心。

sentences.en: Rachel had never seen them arguing.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔从未见过她们吵架。

sentences.en: Diane would bring up Sarah's unemployment during normal conversations, but it was never in a heated way, more so a gentle nudging.
sentences.zh: 黛安会在日常聊天中提起萨拉没工作的事，但语气从来不激烈，更像是一种温和的催促。

sentences.en: Rachel admitted that she'd found the situation with her father, brother and sister weird.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔承认，她觉得父亲、哥哥和妹妹所遭遇的情况很诡异。

sentences.en: She worried that their terminal condition was hereditary and she would catch it next.
sentences.zh: 她担心这种绝症会遗传，下一个轮到她被传染。

sentences.en: Diane had reassured her, saying that Mark had a heart problem,
sentences.zh: 黛安安慰过她，说马克有心脏问题，

sentences.en: Sean's death was due to his seizures, and Sarah's illness was out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 肖恩的死是因为他的癫痫发作，而萨拉的病则来得毫无征兆。

sentences.en: Diane led Rachel to believe that she would be fine.
sentences.zh: 黛安让雷切尔相信她会平安无事。

sentences.en: After Rachel had revealed all of this, a detective told her kindly,
sentences.zh: 在雷切尔透露了这一切之后，一名警探温和地对她说：

sentences.en: What has happened is your mum has admitted to killing your dad and your brother and trying to kill your sister with poison.
sentences.zh: 发生的事情是，你妈妈已经承认她用毒药杀害了你爸爸和哥哥，并试图杀死你的妹妹。

sentences.en: I know it's hard to process and a hard thing to even think about, but she basically spelled it out to us how she did this and the reasons for doing it.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很难接受，甚至很难去想象，但她基本上向我们详述了她是如何做到这一点的以及这样做的动机。

sentences.en: Rachel sat in shock as the truth set in.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔震惊地坐在那里，真相逐渐浮现。

sentences.en: She then began to sob as the detective asked,
sentences.zh: 接着她开始啜泣，这时警探问道：

sentences.en: Did you have any suspicions that mum was doing anything?
sentences.zh: 你有没有怀疑过妈妈在做什么？

sentences.en: Rachel tearfully explained that she knew her mother was frustrated, but she had no idea that she wanted to harm their family.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔含泪解释说，她知道母亲很沮丧，但她根本不知道母亲想伤害他们的家人。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a search of this stouty home uncovered evidence pertaining to Diane's crimes, including a bottle of Preston brand antifreeze engine coolant in the garage.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对这个简朴住所的搜查发现了与黛安罪行有关的证据，其中包括车库里的一瓶普雷斯顿牌防冻发动机冷却液。

sentences.en: Next to it was a six-pack of Coca-Cola.
sentences.zh: 旁边是一包六罐装的可口可乐。

sentences.en: Examination of a laptop revealed that between searches for Christian sheet music and funny cat videos were many others relating to fatal essential oils, poisons used in suicides,
sentences.zh: 对一台笔记本电脑的检查显示，在搜索基督教乐谱和搞笑猫咪视频之间，还有许多其他内容，涉及致命精油、自杀使用的毒药、

sentences.en: herbs that cause stroke, and where to purchase rat poison.
sentences.zh: 会导致中风的草药，以及在哪里购买老鼠药。

sentences.en: The same laptop was used days after Mark Stouty's death to determine lethal doses of over-the-counter pain relief medication for adults weighing 48 kilograMs.
sentences.zh: 就在马克·斯托蒂死后几天，同一台笔记本电脑被用来计算体重48公斤的成人的非处方止痛药致死剂量。

sentences.en: This was Sean Stouty's weight.
sentences.zh: 这就是肖恩·斯托蒂的体重。

sentences.en: Officers searched a bedroom and noticed a purple notebook sitting on top of a shelf.
sentences.zh: 警员搜查了一间卧室，注意到书架顶上放着一本紫色的笔记本。

sentences.en: The word journal was printed across the front cover, and the pages inside were full of handwritten musings about the day-to-day happenings of the Stouty family.
sentences.zh: 封面印着“日记”二字，里面的书页写满了关于斯托蒂一家日常生活的手写感悟。

sentences.en: An entry dated Monday, June 11, 2011 stood out.
sentences.zh: 一篇标日期为2011年6月11日星期一的日记格外引人注目。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: Sometimes I wish I could avoid the future and keep looking to the paSt.
sentences.zh: 有时候我希望自己能避开未来，继续回顾过去。

sentences.en: It's sad when I realise how my father will pass on in the next two months and how Sean, my brother, will move on shortly after.
sentences.zh: 每当我意识到父亲将在接下来的两个月内离世，而我的哥哥肖恩不久后也会离去时，我感到很悲伤。

sentences.en: And yet, it's really helpful.
sentences.zh: 然而，这确实很有帮助。

sentences.en: I'm being warned, so I have more time to prepare and to cope.
sentences.zh: 我得到了警告，所以我有了更多的时间去准备和应对。

sentences.en: Also, I get to have Dad's car when he's gone.
sentences.zh: 而且，父亲不在了之后我还能得到他的车。

sentences.en: It'll be tough getting used to the changes.
sentences.zh: 适应这些变化将会很艰难。

sentences.en: But everything will work out.
sentences.zh: 但一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷迷踪》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案卷迷踪》继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: On her Facebook page, Diane Stouty once posted the quote,
sentences.zh: 黛安·斯托蒂曾在她的Facebook主页上发布过这样一句话：

sentences.en: Never miss an opportunity to tell your child I love you.
sentences.zh: 永远不要错过对你的孩子说“我爱你”的机会。

sentences.en: Despite this, only one Stouty child received the bulk of her affection.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，只有一个斯托蒂家的孩子得到了她大部分的喜爱。

sentences.en: Diane's third oldest, Rachel, was her perfect golden child.
sentences.zh: 黛安排行第三的孩子雷切尔，是她完美的心肝宝贝。

sentences.en: Unlike Sean, Sarah, and Tia, 22-year-old Rachel was uncomplicated.
sentences.zh: 与肖恩、萨拉和蒂娅不同，22岁的雷切尔让人省心。

sentences.en: She didn't face the same struggles as her siblings and was a successful overachiever.
sentences.zh: 她没有经历过和兄弟姐妹一样的挣扎，是一个成功的优等生。

sentences.en: She excelled in school, spoke four languages, and played multiple musical instruments.
sentences.zh: 她在学校表现优异，会说四门语言，还会演奏多种乐器。

sentences.en: She loved maths, chemistry, art, and poetry.
sentences.zh: 她热爱数学、化学、艺术和诗歌。

sentences.en: Diane plastered her Facebook page with praise directed at Rachel, while her other children barely rated a mention.
sentences.zh: 黛安在自己的Facebook主页上大肆赞美雷切尔，而她的其他孩子几乎鲜少被提及。

sentences.en: It was clear Rachel was Diane's favourite, and the pair shared a remarkably close, best friend-type bond.
sentences.zh: 很明显，雷切尔是黛安的最爱，两人的关系好得惊人，宛如闺蜜。

sentences.en: They understood one another and confided in each other.
sentences.zh: 他们互相理解，无话不谈。

sentences.en: Rachel also confided in her personal diary, a journal with a purple cover that she kept on a shelf in her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔也会向她个人的日记本倾诉，那是一本封面为紫色的日记，被她放在卧室的书架上。

sentences.en: Mark and Sean were killed nearly a year after the entry Rachel made predicting their deaths, well over the two-month deadline she had anticipated.
sentences.zh: 马克和肖恩遇害时，距离雷切尔写下预测他们死亡的日记已将近一年，远超她所预料的两个月期限。

sentences.en: Yet, the fact she even knew about them beforehand was surprising.
sentences.zh: 然而，她竟然提前知道了这些事，这还是让人感到惊讶。

sentences.en: And a search of Rachel's purse uncovered a poem she had written after Sarah was hospitalised.
sentences.zh: 而对雷切尔手提包的搜查发现了一首她在萨拉住院后写下的诗。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: Once upon a time there were six, and now there are only three.
sentences.zh: 从前有六个人，现在只剩下三个。

sentences.en: Only the quiet ones are left.
sentences.zh: 只剩下那些安静的人了。

sentences.en: My mum, my little sister, and me.
sentences.zh: 我的妈妈，我的小妹妹，还有我。

sentences.en: In Diane's police interview, she had insisted that no one else knew what she'd done.
sentences.zh: 在黛安的警方讯问中，她坚称没有其他人知道她所做的事。

sentences.en: During Rachel's interview, she was asked directly if she had any involvement in her mother's scheme.
sentences.zh: 在对雷切尔的讯问中，她被直接问及是否参与了她母亲的计划。

sentences.en: Rachel had shook her head no and cried.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔摇了摇头说没有，并哭了起来。

sentences.en: Following the discovery of Rachel's diary, police conducted another interview with her.
sentences.zh: 在发现雷切尔的日记后，警方对她进行了另一次讯问。

sentences.en: They kept a word of the find to themselves and instead just asked how she felt about what her mother had done.
sentences.zh: 他们对这一发现守口如瓶，只是问她对母亲所做的事有什么看法。

sentences.en: Rachel said she was confused and shocked, explaining,
sentences.zh: 雷切尔说她感到困惑和震惊，并解释道：

sentences.en: No one expects to have somebody that they know do that.
sentences.zh: 没人会指望自己认识的人做出这种事。

sentences.en: I mean, who judges who can live?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谁来评判谁能活下去？

sentences.en: Did your mother ever say anything to you about any of your family members being in bad health and that they were going to die in the near future?
sentences.zh: 你母亲有没有对你说过，你们的任何家庭成员健康状况不佳，并且会在不久的将来死去？

sentences.en: Rachel said that her mother had spoken about Mark smoking and drinking.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔说她母亲曾谈论过马克吸烟和喝酒的事。

sentences.en: She said if he kept it up, then he wasn't going to make it to the age of 80.
sentences.zh: 她说过如果他继续这样下去，就活不到80岁了。

sentences.en: Rachel claimed that Diane had never mentioned anything about Sean or Sarah's future.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔声称黛安从未提过任何关于肖恩或萨拉未来的事。

sentences.en: Rachel was shown a banal entry from the purple journal found in the stouty home.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔被出示了从斯托蒂家中发现的紫色日记本里的一篇平淡无奇的日记。

sentences.en: She confirmed the diary was hers and that she had written the entries within.
sentences.zh: 她确认这本日记是她的，里面的内容也是她写的。

sentences.en: She was then shown the entry where she predicted Mark and Sean's deaths.
sentences.zh: 随后，她被出示了那篇预测马克和肖恩死亡的日记。

sentences.en: Rachel thought for a moment before explaining that she had a dream around that time that Mark and Sean would die.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔思索了一会儿，然后解释说她在那个时间段做过一个梦，梦见马克和肖恩会死。

sentences.en: She claimed she told her mother about the dream.
sentences.zh: 她声称自己把这个梦告诉了母亲。

sentences.en: What did you tell your mother?
sentences.zh: 你跟你母亲说了什么？

sentences.en: The police asked.
sentences.zh: 警方问。

sentences.en: Rachel started to sob tearlessly as she replied.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔无声地啜泣着，回答道。

sentences.en: Rachel continued to open up, stating matter-of-factly, I didn't know when my mother bought the antifreeze, but I knew she'd been doctoring drinks with that.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔继续敞开心扉，实事求是地说道：“我不知道我母亲是什么时候买的防冻液，但我知道她一直在往饮料里下毒。”

sentences.en: Although the interviewing detective was stunned by Rachel's admission, he remained cool and kept asking questions.
sentences.zh: 尽管正在讯问的警探被雷切尔的供认惊呆了，但他保持着冷静并继续追问。

sentences.en: Rachel admitted that her mother had confided in her about her intention to kill the others.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔承认母亲曾向她吐露过想要杀死其他人的意图。

sentences.en: She offered more insight as to how the plan came to fruition.
sentences.zh: 她透露了更多关于该计划是如何付诸实施的内幕。

sentences.en: After Diane settled on antifreeze as her murder weapon, she purchased it online.
sentences.zh: 在黛安确定防冻液作为杀人工具后，她在网上购买了它。

sentences.en: This was because antifreeze sold in stores has an added bittering agent to prevent accidental ingestion.
sentences.zh: 这是因为商店里售卖的防冻液添加了苦味剂以防止误服。

sentences.en: Diane kept a small amount of antifreeze hidden in a container under the kitchen sink.
sentences.zh: 黛安把少量的防冻液藏在厨房水槽下一个容器里。

sentences.en: She would tip out two inches or so of whatever drink she'd poured for Mark, Sean, or Sarah, and then refill it with the poison.
sentences.zh: 她会倒掉为马克、肖恩或萨拉倒的任何饮料中的大约两英寸，然后用毒药补满。

sentences.en: By this point in Rachel's interview, she'd admitted to knowing that her mother was intending to kill family members, but maintained that she'd acted alone.
sentences.zh: 到雷切尔受审的这个阶段，她已经承认自己知道母亲意图杀死家人，但坚称母亲是独自行动的。

sentences.en: Yet, when explaining how Diane researched by reading a book about poisonous plants,
sentences.zh: 然而，当解释黛安是如何通过阅读一本关于毒植物的书来做研究时，

sentences.en: Rachel initially said, we would, before quickly correcting her answer to, she would.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔最初说的是“我们会”，随后迅速改口纠正为“她会”。

sentences.en: Detectives suspected they weren't getting the full story.
sentences.zh: 警探们怀疑他们并没有得到全部的真相。

sentences.en: They told Rachel that they'd seized the laptop she and Diane shared and asked what they'd find on it.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉雷切尔，他们已经查封了她和黛安共用的笔记本电脑，并问在上面会找到什么。

sentences.en: Rachel admitted that she had once searched how to kill someone.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔承认她曾经搜索过如何杀人。

sentences.en: The interviewing detective then asked a risky question, not expecting to receive the answer he was looking for.
sentences.zh: 负责讯问的警探随后提出了一个冒险的问题，并没有指望能得到他想要的答案。

sentences.en: Your mother would pour some of the drink out and then she would put the antifreeze in the drink and then give it to your father.
sentences.zh: 你母亲会倒掉一些饮料，然后把防冻液放进饮料里，接着把它给你父亲。

sentences.en: How often did you do that?
sentences.zh: 这种事你们做了多久？

sentences.en: After thinking for a moment, Rachel replied coolly,
sentences.zh: 思索片刻后，雷切尔冷静地回答：

sentences.en: once.
sentences.zh: 一次。

sentences.en: The detective was stunned.
sentences.zh: 警探惊呆了。

sentences.en: When he pressed Rachel to be honest, she clarified her answer.
sentences.zh: 当他敦促雷切尔说实话时，她澄清了自己的答案。

sentences.en: Three, four times.
sentences.zh: 三四次。

sentences.en: This gradual drip feed of information formed the basis of Rachel's confession.
sentences.zh: 这种逐渐挤牙膏式的信息透露构成了雷切尔供词的基础。

sentences.en: She would initially give a broad, uncertain or deceptive answer before being grilled with follow-up questions.
sentences.zh: 她最初会给出笼统、不确定或带有欺骗性的回答，然后受到后续问题的严厉盘问。

sentences.en: Eventually, she gave detailed, consistent answers that aligned with the facts of the case.
sentences.zh: 最终，她给出了与案件事实相吻合的详细、一致的回答。

sentences.en: She was first interrogated about her father's death.
sentences.zh: 她首先就她父亲的死接受了审讯。

sentences.en: It was a trade-off, Rachel said casually.
sentences.zh: 这是一场交易，雷切尔随口说道。

sentences.en: Mum would do it.
sentences.zh: 妈妈会这么做。

sentences.en: Then I would.
sentences.zh: 然后就轮到我。

sentences.en: Rachel mixed the drinks for her father twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening, for several weeks.
sentences.zh: 在数周的时间里，雷切尔一天两次为父亲调制有毒饮料，一次在早上，一次在晚上。

sentences.en: She didn't have a clear schedule with her mother, who typically administered her poisonings
sentences.zh: 她和母亲并没有明确的时间表，母亲通常在下午施毒，

sentences.en: in the afternoon, so they often overlapped and served many poisoned drinks to mark a day.
sentences.zh: 所以她们的行动经常重叠，一天下来会给马克端去许多有毒的饮料。

sentences.en: As Rachel's story unraveled, it was clear she'd participated in the poisonings more than just the three or four times she had initially admitted to.
sentences.zh: 随着雷切尔的故事真相大白，很明显她参与下毒的次数远不止她最初承认的三四次。

sentences.en: Mark didn't fall sick at firSt.
sentences.zh: 马克起初并没有生病。

sentences.en: Diane reassured Rachel, telling her, it will take time.
sentences.zh: 黛安安慰雷切尔，对她说：“这需要时间。”

sentences.en: It was several weeks before Mark finally became ill.
sentences.zh: 过了好几个星期，马克才终于病倒。

sentences.en: The women continued to poison him with higher doses.
sentences.zh: 两个女人继续用更高剂量的毒药毒害他。

sentences.en: By the end, Mark's drinks consisted of half soda or Gatorade and half antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 到了最后，马克的饮料里一半是苏打水或佳得乐，另一半则是防冻液。

sentences.en: Diane and Rachel went through upwards of five bottles of antifreeze in their efforts to kill him.
sentences.zh: 为了杀死马克，黛安和雷切尔用掉了多达五瓶以上的防冻液。

sentences.en: Despite having previously praised her father, Rachel now claimed that Mark was killed because he was turbulent and abusive.
sentences.zh: 尽管此前曾赞美过父亲，但雷切尔现在声称马克被杀是因为他脾气暴躁且有虐待倾向。

sentences.en: This was at odds with her own diary, where Rachel had written that her father would, quote, rather cut off his own arm than hurt us.
sentences.zh: 这与她自己的日记相矛盾，雷切尔在日记中写道，她的父亲“宁愿砍掉自己的胳膊也不会伤害我们”。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, she went on to write that her father was still more of a hindrance alive.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她接着写道，活着父亲仍然是个累赘。

sentences.en: Rachel said she mixed a drink a day for Sean and one every so often for Sarah, but mostly used bottles of Coca-Cola or Gatorade that Diane had pre-mixed in advance.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔说她每天为肖恩调制一杯饮料，偶尔为萨拉调制一杯，但大多使用的是黛安提前混合好的瓶装可口可乐或佳得乐。

sentences.en: When asked, why did you guys want to kill them?
sentences.zh: 当被问及“你们为什么要杀他们”时？

sentences.en: Rachel replied indifferently,
sentences.zh: 雷切尔冷漠地回答：

sentences.en: Sean, I accepted that mum wanted him gone, but I really didn't think he was necessary.
sentences.zh: 肖恩，我接受妈妈想让他离开的想法，但我真的觉得没必要这么做。

sentences.en: After further pressing, Rachel admitted that she found Sean annoying.
sentences.zh: 经过进一步追问，雷切尔承认她觉得肖恩很烦人。

sentences.en: As for Sarah, Rachel said,
sentences.zh: 至于萨拉，雷切尔说：

sentences.en: I really actually wasn't aware that mum was getting Sarah.
sentences.zh: 我实际上真的不知道妈妈连萨拉也不放过。

sentences.en: I knew about Sean, I knew about dad, but I didn't know she was going to go ahead with Sarah.
sentences.zh: 我知道肖恩的事，我知道爸爸的事，但我不知道她还要对萨拉下手。

sentences.en: As usual, Rachel's lies didn't hold up under further scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 像往常一样，雷切尔的谎言经不起进一步的推敲。

sentences.en: She soon admitted that she had known about the plan to kill Sarah a month beforehand.
sentences.zh: 她不久便承认，她一个月前就知道了杀死萨拉的计划。

sentences.en: As to why they wanted Sarah dead, Rachel explained.
sentences.zh: 至于为什么他们想让萨拉死，雷切尔解释道。

sentences.en: Other than the fact that she basically lived in the back bedroom and didn't have any gumption to get a job, I'm not certain.
sentences.zh: 除了她基本上住在后卧室里而且没有任何找工作的动力之外，我也不太确定。

sentences.en: Mum probably has her own issues with her.
sentences.zh: 妈妈对她可能有什么自己的看法吧。

sentences.en: The detective asked, what about you?
sentences.zh: 警探问：“那你呢？”

sentences.en: Rachel took a deep breath before replying.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔深吸了一口气，然后回答道。

sentences.en: She's annoying, yes, but I don't know.
sentences.zh: 她确实很烦人，是的，但我不知道。

sentences.en: Rachel eventually admitted that she found Sarah very nosy and they fought all the time.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔最终承认，她觉得莎拉非常爱管闲事，而且她俩经常吵架。

sentences.en: She added bluntly,
sentences.zh: 她直言不讳地补充道：

sentences.en: Back in middle school, Sarah would touch me.
sentences.zh: 早在中学时，莎拉就会对动手动脚。

sentences.en: I mean, she grew out of it later when she got on the medicine, but she still argues.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她后来吃药后有所收敛，但她还是会争吵。

sentences.en: She still has really inappropriate jokes.
sentences.zh: 她仍然会开一些很不合时宜的玩笑。

sentences.en: She really had no purpose.
sentences.zh: 她确实毫无用处。

sentences.en: Rachel clarified that the touching she was referring to was both physical and sexual, but Sarah acted like she couldn't remember it.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔澄清说，她所指的动手动脚既包括身体上的，也包括性方面的，但莎拉表现得好像完全不记得了。

sentences.en: Despite the seriousness of these allegations and the fact that Rachel was implying deep, prolonged trauma had motivated her to kill Sarah, she never referred to it again.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些指控非常严重，而且雷切尔暗示是长期而深重的创伤驱使她杀害了莎拉，但她再也没有提起过这件事。

sentences.en: Investigators thought it was convenient that Rachel said Sarah had no recollection of it either.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，雷切尔说莎拉也完全不记得此事，这实在是太巧了。

sentences.en: As Rachel was a proven liar, they believed she'd made up the shocking accusation to make Sarah's murder appear understandable.
sentences.zh: 由于雷切尔是个惯犯，警方认为她编造了这一骇人听闻的指控，以让谋杀莎拉的行为显得可以理解。

sentences.en: It still didn't provide any justification as to why she'd participated in killing Mark and Sean beforehand.
sentences.zh: 但这仍然无法解释她之前为什么会参与谋杀马克和肖恩。

sentences.en: Rachel made yet another revelation.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔又透露了一个内幕。

sentences.en: She claimed Sarah was in on the murder plot too.
sentences.zh: 她声称莎拉也参与了谋杀计划。

sentences.en: Police were incredulous.
sentences.zh: 警方对此感到难以置信。

sentences.en: If Sarah was aware of and involved in the plan to poison Mark and Sean, then she would know not to accept any drinks herself,
sentences.zh: 如果莎拉知道并参与了毒害马克和肖恩的计划，那她自己就应该知道绝不能接受任何饮料，

sentences.en: especially once she started developing symptoMs. Rachel said that when Sarah fell ill,
sentences.zh: 特别是当她开始出现症状的时候。雷切尔说，当莎拉生病时，

sentences.en: Rachel and Diane would reply, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔和黛安会回答：我不知道。

sentences.en: Sarah didn't ask or accuse them of poisoning her, despite allegedly knowing that they had done it twice before.
sentences.zh: 尽管莎拉据称知道她们之前已经下毒两次，但她并没有质问或指责她们给自己下毒。

sentences.en: Nor did she reach out to anyone else or seek help on her own volition.
sentences.zh: 她也没有联系其他人或主动寻求帮助。

sentences.en: In Rachel's own words, Sarah was very afraid of death and often talked about not wanting to die.
sentences.zh: 用雷切尔自己的话说，莎拉非常害怕死亡，经常谈到自己不想死。

sentences.en: Detectives felt that these actions didn't align with the narrative that
sentences.zh: 侦探们觉得，这些行为与

sentences.en: Sarah knew what her mother and sister were up to.
sentences.zh: 莎拉知道她母亲和姐姐在搞什么鬼这一说法并不相符。

sentences.en: Then there was the question as to why Diane and
sentences.zh: 此外还有一个问题，那就是为什么黛安和

sentences.en: Rachel had taken Sarah to the hospital for treatment.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔会把莎拉送到医院治疗。

sentences.en: Rachel revealed this wasn't done due to any sense of care, compassion, or a desire to save Sarah's life.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔透露，这样做并不是出于任何关爱、同情或想要拯救莎拉生命的想法。

sentences.en: It was Rachel's idea because she, quote, didn't want another one to die in the house, because houses are nasty after somebody's died in it.
sentences.zh: 这是雷切尔的主意，因为她引述道：不想让另一个人死在家里，因为人死在家里后房子会变得很不干净。

sentences.en: After Sean died, Rachel moved into his room and was plagued by nightmares.
sentences.zh: 肖恩死后，雷切尔搬进了他的房间，并饱受噩梦折磨。

sentences.en: She said it was awful that she kept sensing a ghostly presence in the space and she didn't want to experience that again when Sarah passed.
sentences.zh: 她说，她一直感觉到那个空间里有幽灵存在，这种感觉太可怕了，当莎拉过世时，她不想再次经历这种事。

sentences.en: Rachel's fear seemed genuine.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔的恐惧似乎是真实的。

sentences.en: She was uncharacteristically nervous and shaky when discussing the haunting in Sean's room.
sentences.zh: 在谈到肖恩房间闹鬼的事情时，她一反常态地紧张和发抖。

sentences.en: She had also written about it in her diary immediately following Sean's death.
sentences.zh: 在肖恩死后不久，她也在日记中写下了这件事。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Yet, I feel your gaze lingering over me.
sentences.zh: 然而，我感觉你的目光依然停留在我身上。

sentences.en: I close my eyes and try not to think of the ghosts of copper and bleach.
sentences.zh: 我闭上眼睛，尽量不去想铜和漂白剂的幽灵。

sentences.en: On my tongue, I try not to think of shuddery breaths or how easily a soul evaporates,
sentences.zh: 在我舌尖上，我尽量不去想颤抖的呼吸，或者灵魂是如何轻易蒸发的，

sentences.en: leaving nothing behind but a hollow husk curled up on the floor, eyes vacant and dull, arms extended.
sentences.zh: 只留下一个蜷缩在地板上的空壳，双眼空洞呆滞，双臂伸展。

sentences.en: But, what were you reaching for?
sentences.zh: 但是，你到底在渴望什么？

sentences.en: As for the youngest stouty child, Tia, Rachel admitted that she and
sentences.zh: 至于最小的孩子蒂亚，雷切尔承认她和

sentences.en: Diane had planned to kill her after Sarah.
sentences.zh: 黛安计划在莎拉之后杀掉她。

sentences.en: The motive was similar to Sean.
sentences.zh: 动机和肖恩相似。

sentences.en: Tia's learning disabilities were a burden and they didn't want to look after her.
sentences.zh: 蒂亚的学习障碍是个累赘，她们不想照顾她。

sentences.en: Rachel remarked,
sentences.zh: 雷切尔评论道：

sentences.en: Following Rachel's harrowing confession, police re-interviewed Diane.
sentences.zh: 在雷切尔令人揪心的供认之后，警方重新盘问了黛安。

sentences.en: Upon learning that her daughter had confessed, Diane made full admissions that she and Rachel had planned, researched and committed the crimes together.
sentences.zh: 在得知女儿已经招供后，黛安全盘承认她和雷切尔共同策划、谋划并实施了这些犯罪。

sentences.en: Neither woman expressed a genuine remorse or regret.
sentences.zh: 两个女人都没有表现出真正的悔意或歉意。

sentences.en: Nor did Diane show any hint of sadness for sacrificing Rachel's promising future in favour of grooming her to be her partner in crime.
sentences.zh: 黛安也没有表现出一丝悲伤，尽管她为了把雷切尔培养成自己的同谋而毁掉了对方的光明未来。

sentences.en: By the time Diane and Rachel's deadly plot was exposed, Sarah Stouty's condition had changed dramatically.
sentences.zh: 当黛安和雷切尔的致命阴谋败露时，莎拉·斯陶蒂的情况已经发生了戏剧性的变化。

sentences.en: Although hospital staff had given her a 0% chance of survival when she was first admitted, in a miraculous turn of events she was slowly recovering.
sentences.zh: 尽管刚入院时医院的工作人员认为她生还的几率为零，但在奇迹般的转折下，她正在慢慢康复。

sentences.en: Both Diane and Rachel were surprised to learn of Sarah's survival, though not relieved.
sentences.zh: 黛安和雷切尔得知莎拉幸存后都感到很惊讶，但并非感到欣慰。

sentences.en: Rachel had even nodded her head and said yes when asked if she still wanted Sarah to die.
sentences.zh: 当被问及是否仍然希望莎拉死时，雷切尔甚至点了点头并说了是。

sentences.en: But Sarah's ordeal wasn't over.
sentences.zh: 但莎拉的磨难还没有结束。

sentences.en: The strokes and seizures she'd endured left her with severe neurological damage.
sentences.zh: 她经历的中风和癫痫给她留下了严重的神经损伤。

sentences.en: She had to relearn to walk and talk.
sentences.zh: 她不得不重新学习走路和说话。

sentences.en: When Sarah was well enough, she agreed to a police interview.
sentences.zh: 当莎拉身体状况足够好时，她同意接受警方采访。

sentences.en: She hadn't yet been informed that her mother and sister had confessed to poisoning her.
sentences.zh: 她当时还不知道她的母亲和姐姐已经承认给她下毒。

sentences.en: Investigators wanted to get to the bottom of Rachel's claim that Sarah had known about their crimes.
sentences.zh: 调查人员想要弄清雷切尔声称莎拉知道她们罪行的说法是否属实。

sentences.en: Sarah was told that police had been investigating why she had fallen sick.
sentences.zh: 警察告诉莎拉，他们一直在调查她生病的原因。

sentences.en: What do you think we found out?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我们发现了什么？

sentences.en: Detectives asked.
sentences.zh: 侦探们问。

sentences.en: Sarah replied, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 莎拉回答：我不知道。

sentences.en: Sarah said no.
sentences.zh: 莎拉说没有。

sentences.en: All I know is that I got sick.
sentences.zh: 我只知道我生病了。

sentences.en: Sarah was then informed that her mother and sister had admitted to making her unwell.
sentences.zh: 随后，莎拉被告知她的母亲和姐姐已经承认是她们让她生病的。

sentences.en: Sarah went on to recount an experience she'd had after Mark and
sentences.zh: 莎拉接着讲述了她在马克和

sentences.en: Sean died.
sentences.zh: 肖恩死后的一次经历。

sentences.en: One day, she found her mother's personal diary.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她找到了她母亲的个人日记。

sentences.en: Sarah opened it and found an entry Diane had written about Mark and Sean's deaths.
sentences.zh: 莎拉打开日记，发现了一篇黛安写的关于马克和肖恩之死的记录。

sentences.en: To Sarah's shock, the entry also referred to her own death.
sentences.zh: 令莎拉震惊的是，这篇记录里还提到了她自己的死。

sentences.en: Unnerved, Sarah confronted her mother, but her concerns were dismissed and she was warned not to go looking in the diary again.
sentences.zh: 莎拉感到心神不宁，便去找母亲对质，但她的担忧被驳回了，并被警告不要再翻看日记。

sentences.en: Sarah said this hadn't alerted her to the fact that her mother or sister were responsible for making Mark, Sean, or herself sick.
sentences.zh: 莎拉说，这并没有让她意识到是她的母亲或姐姐导致马克、肖恩或她自己生病的。

sentences.en: Sarah flat out denied being involved in any part of the scheme and nothing that was uncovered suggested she'd known what was going on.
sentences.zh: 莎拉断然否认自己参与了该计划的任何部分，而且没有任何证据表明她知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: Detectives believed Sarah, but in any case, her brain had been seriously damaged by the antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 侦探们相信了莎拉，但无论如何，她的脑子已经被防冻液严重损坏了。

sentences.en: It was obvious from their conversations that her mind was foggy and she didn't fully comprehend what was being asked.
sentences.zh: 从他们的谈话中可以明显看出，她的思维很混乱，并没有完全理解对方在问什么。

sentences.en: Given Sarah's condition and the lack of evidence pertaining to her guilt, detectives ended these inquiries with the belief that she was an innocent victim.
sentences.zh: 鉴于莎拉的身体状况以及缺乏她有罪的证据，侦探们结束了这些调查，认为她是一名无辜的受害者。

sentences.en: Diane Stouty was ultimately charged with two counts of first-degree murder for Mark and Sean, as well as one count of
sentences.zh: 黛安·斯陶蒂最终被控两项针对马克和肖恩的一级谋杀罪，以及一项

sentences.en: first-degree assault and one of armed criminal action for the crimes against Sarah.
sentences.zh: 针对莎拉的一级攻击罪和一项持械犯罪活动罪。

sentences.en: Rachel Stouty was charged with the same offences.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔·斯陶蒂被控相同的罪名。

sentences.en: In May 2015, three years after the poisonings began, Rachel pleaded guilty as part of a deal.
sentences.zh: 2015年5月，即投毒事件开始三年后，雷切尔通过认罪协议认罪。

sentences.en: In exchange for testifying against her mother at trial, Rachel would be eligible for parole one day.
sentences.zh: 作为在审判中指证她母亲的交换条件，雷切尔将来有望获得假释。

sentences.en: At her sentencing, Rachel read an apology she had penned to her sister Sarah.
sentences.zh: 在宣判时，雷切尔宣读了她写给妹妹莎拉的道歉信。

sentences.en: In it, she claimed she was haunted by the reality of loss and grieved knowing that her guilt wasn't a passing phase.
sentences.zh: 在信中，她声称自己一直被失去亲人的现实所困扰，并为自己的罪过并非一时糊涂而感到痛苦。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Your suffering could have been prevented and I hate myself for not being there for you.
sentences.zh: 你的痛苦本可以避免，我恨自己当时没有陪在你身边。

sentences.en: Things will never be the same, but I can try to change to become a better person.
sentences.zh: 一切都回不到过去了，但我可以努力改变，成为一个更好的人。

sentences.en: I want you to know that you are an inspiration to me.
sentences.zh: 我想让你知道，你一直是我的灵感源泉。

sentences.en: Thank you for showing me what I can be.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你让我看到了我能成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: Rachel Stouty, who was now 25 years old, was sentenced to life in prison with the possibility of parole in 42 years.
sentences.zh: 雷切尔·斯陶蒂现年25岁，被判处终身监禁，42年后可获得假释。

sentences.en: In January 2016, Diane Stouty also accepted a plea deal.
sentences.zh: 2016年1月，黛安·斯陶蒂也接受了认罪协议。

sentences.en: She agreed to plead guilty to all but the armed criminal action charge in order to avoid potentially receiving the death penalty if the case went to trial.
sentences.zh: 她同意对除持械犯罪活动罪之外的所有指控认罪，以避免如果案件开庭审判可能面临死刑判决。

sentences.en: She was subsequently sentenced to life in prison without parole.
sentences.zh: 随后，她被判处终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: Since her incarceration, Diane has changed her story yet again.
sentences.zh: 自入狱以来，黛安再次改变了她的说法。

sentences.en: In a 2022 interview with ABC's 2020, Diane claimed that she was completely innocent.
sentences.zh: 在2022年接受美国广播公司《20/20》节目的采访时，黛安声称自己是完全无辜的。

sentences.en: She said that her husband was associated with dangerous people who'd put out a hit on him.
sentences.zh: 她说她的丈夫与一些危险人物有交往，这些人曾悬赏要他的命。

sentences.en: Someone from within that circle was responsible for poisoning him.
sentences.zh: 那个圈子里的人对他的中毒负有责任。

sentences.en: She even went on to claim that she had been poisoned at one point, though she offered no explanation as to how Sean and Sarah came to be victims as well.
sentences.zh: 她甚至声称自己曾一度被下毒，不过她没有解释肖恩和莎拉是如何成为受害者的。

sentences.en: A case detective clarified,
sentences.zh: 一名案件侦探澄清说：

sentences.en: There is nothing whatsoever to show that anybody was involved in this case other than those mentioned already.
sentences.zh: 没有任何迹象表明除了已经提到的人之外，还有其他人参与了此案。

sentences.en: If Rachel Stouty hadn't incriminated herself in her diary, there was a very real
sentences.zh: 如果雷切尔·斯陶蒂没有在日记中自我坦白，那么她参与投毒这一事实

sentences.en: possibility that her involvement in the poisonings that her involvement in the poisonings would have never been uncovered.
sentences.zh: 很有可能永远都不会被发现。

sentences.en: A clinical and forensic psychologist told A&E that the diary entries were evidence of how much control Diane exerted over Rachel.
sentences.zh: 一位临床和法医心理学家告诉A&E电视台，日记内容证明了黛安对雷切尔的控制有多深。

sentences.en: It had reached the point where Rachel was fully convinced of her mother's scheme, believing it was, quote, just the way it has to be.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况已经发展到雷切尔对她母亲的计划深信不疑，认为这引述：只能如此。

sentences.en: Therefore, she journaled about it as if it were any other mundane experience she was dealing with in her life.
sentences.zh: 因此，她把这件事记录在日记里，就像记录她生活中遇到的任何其他平淡经历一样。

sentences.en: As a result of Sarah Stouty's permanent neurological damage, she now lives in an assisted care facility and has a state-appointed guardian.
sentences.zh: 由于莎拉·斯陶蒂永久性的神经损伤，她现在住在一家护理机构，并由国家指定的监护人照顾。

sentences.en: Sarah was unable to care for her youngest sibling, Tia, who was consequently placed in foster care.
sentences.zh: 莎拉无法照顾她最小的弟弟蒂亚，因此蒂亚被送入了寄养家庭。

sentences.en: In a statement read aloud in court, Sarah said,
sentences.zh: 在法庭上宣读的一份声明中，莎拉说：

sentences.en: I prefer to be a survivor than a victim.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿做个幸存者，也不愿做个受害者。

sentences.en: She intends to fulfil her dream of travelling to France and becoming a translator.
sentences.zh: 她打算实现去法国旅游并成为一名翻译的梦想。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Sarah campaigns to raise awareness of antifreeze poisoning.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，莎拉积极开展活动，提高人们对防冻液中毒的认识。

sentences.en: Following Sarah's ordeal, she struggled the most with how much she missed her father and brother.
sentences.zh: 经历这场磨难后，莎拉最难释怀的是她多么想念父亲和哥哥。

sentences.en: She lives her life believing their spirits protect her.
sentences.zh: 她坚信他们的灵魂一直在保护她，以此支撑着生活。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: Mark and Sean are like angels watching over me, and every once in a while I have dreams that they visit me.
sentences.zh: 马克和肖恩就像守护天使一样看着我，每隔一段时间我就会梦到他们来看我。

sentences.en: Although Sarah was angry when she found out her mother and sister had poisoned her, she has since moved past this feeling.
sentences.zh: 尽管莎拉得知母亲和姐姐给自己下毒时非常愤怒，但她现在已经放下了这种情绪。

sentences.en: I forgive them for what they did, because forgiveness is the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 我原谅她们所做的事，因为宽恕是正确的做法。
